  Why 2.1.6 and not 2.1.7: 2.1.7 was one day old when this was written. The only difference between the two
  UMD builds is an internal regex in the CSS text splitter for <style> elements with several text nodes
  (not used by GH Coin), so the older, longer-published release was taken.

  rrweb-record.min.js runs inside the bot page (injected by ghcoin-dash through Chrome DevTools, see recorder.js).
  rrweb-replay.min.js + rrweb-replay.css run in the viewer's browser (live.html).

To update: npm pack the new version, check sha512 against `npm view @rrweb/<pkg>@<ver> dist.integrity`, copy the
same three files, update this table and the SHA-256 pins in ../../add-dashboard.sh, then test (recorder.js and
live.js use options and one private replay field: replayer.service.state.context.events).
